## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test:coverage` pass
- [ ] New code has tests
- [ ] A user-visible change to the app has an entry under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] A change to the SDK or the CLI has a changeset (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] A change to the format, an endpoint, a client limit or an error code is in `PROTOCOL.md`
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in the diff
